name: @tetherto/mdk-plugin-basic-auth
description: HTTP Basic Auth gate for a site's Gateway routes, credentials sourced from SiteLaunch.spec.auth at sites.create time and never handed to this process as plaintext -- only a per-site salt+hash reach it, via env vars (see src/server.js's createSiteRpc and src/supervisor.js's spawnSite). Wired into the real dashboard.overview route (guarded whenever spec.auth is configured; unaffected otherwise) as well as this plugin's own standalone route below. See design/plugin-basic-auth.md for the original design write-up, including why this can only protect routes that opt in by calling requireBasicAuth() themselves (no framework-level route wrapping/interception exists) and why failures surface as HTTP 400 rather than a real 401 -- both confirmed against the real Gateway, see maintainers/architecture.md.

200.description: Same payload as dashboard.overview (deviceId/workerId/workerState + spread telemetry), gated behind HTTP Basic Auth.

400.description: Missing/malformed Authorization header, or the submitted username/password don't match the site's configured credential. See plugin-basic-auth.md for why this is 400 and not 401.

routes.description: Demonstrates the shared requireBasicAuth() guard by reproducing templates/minimal-site/plugins/dashboard/controllers/overview.js's exact body with one added line at the top. Kept as its own standalone route alongside the real dashboard.overview route (which now applies the same guard when spec.auth is configured), so the guard's behavior can be exercised independently of the main overview route.
